checks.evidence: Exactly one reviewer evidence-path row exists for each paper-facing RQ/core experiment.
Each row records main paper evidence, source artifact, guardrail, and scoped non-claim.
RQ2 links hidden-label localization numbers to the fixed-session baseline-scope guardrail.
RQ3 links executable patches, boundary-field repair, task cards, and mechanism counterpoints.
Chinese and English papers mention the R369 reviewer evidence-path table.
Evaluation ledger records R369 as a paper-integration guardrail.
Evidence path preserves operation/operation-stack abstractions and must-not-claim boundaries.
R369 reads tracked paper/docs/artifacts only; it downloads no data and reruns no profiler.
